stories.title: Laver Cup 2026 Day 1 — Action Gets Underway at The O2

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text: Day 1 is HERE. 🎾 @LaverCup London kicks off at The O2: Ruud vs Cerúndolo opens the day session, then Menšík vs Nakashima. Tonight: debutants Jódar vs Bublik — then Alcaraz & Menšík in doubles. Europe leads 8-1 all-time but World are defending champs. Let's go.

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text: Night session is ON at The O2. Jódar vs Bublik — two Laver Cup debutants making their debuts right now. Then Alcaraz & Menšík take on Fritz & Bublik in doubles. World need to get on the board early. #LaverCup2026

stories.title: Sinner Officially Withdraws From China Open — Knee Not Ready

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text: OFFICIAL: Jannik Sinner withdraws from the 2026 China Open. His statement: "My knee is not where I would like it to be, and I'm not ready to compete." The world No. 1 has not played since Wimbledon. Title defense over before it started.

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text: Sinner out of Beijing. Now the question: Shanghai (Oct 5) or Vienna (Oct 26)? His team hasn't confirmed a return date. ATP Finals spot is already locked at No. 2 in the Race. But the knee concern is real — he's missed 3 months.

article.headline: Sinner Officially Withdraws From China Open: "My Knee Is Not Where I Would Like It to Be"

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text: Medvedev enters the draw today at the Hangzhou Open (ATP 250). No. 1 seed faces Valentin Royer in the R16 — the Frenchman beat Walton 6-3, 6-4 to earn this shot. Most top-10 are in London at Laver Cup, so this field is wide open.

stories.title: Chengdu Open Day 3 — Mannarino Shocks Shang, Shapovalov's 250th Win

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text: Chengdu Open upset alert: Adrian Mannarino (38) def. former champion Shang Juncheng 7-6(9), 6-2. Shapovalov earned his 250th career win. Mannarino now faces defending champ Tabilo in the R16. Home crowd stunned. #ATPChengdu
